utterances.text: Hello dear, how have you been?
Hi Grandma! I've been good, just busy with school and stuff. How about you?
I hope everything is going well for you. Is there anything you'd like to share?
Well, I've been thinking about joining a new club at school. It's a bit different from what I usually do, but it sounds fun!
You seem a bit quiet today. Is everything alright?
Oh, I'm fine, just a bit tired from all the studying. Thanks for asking, Grandma.
Oh, I see! That sounds interesting. Let's give it a try and see how it works.
Thanks, Grandma! I'm really looking forward to it. I think it'll be a great way to meet new people and learn something new.
Well, if so many people find it helpful, it must be worth a try. I'm always open to learning new things.
I'm glad you're open to it, Grandma. It's always fun to try new things together!
I'm glad we're trying something new together. It's always fun to experiment.
Absolutely! I'm really excited to see how it goes. Do you think we should invite anyone else to join us?
That's fascinating! I didn't know that about fish. You're teaching me so much today.
I'm glad you're enjoying it, Grandma! Maybe we can learn more about different types of fish together.
Oh my, you're brave! I remember when I first touched a fish, it was quite an experience.
That sounds like a fun memory! Maybe we can create some new ones together.
That's great to hear! You're becoming quite the expert at this.
Thanks, Grandma! I love learning new things with you. Maybe we can try cooking some fish recipes next time.
That's okay, take your time. It's all about learning and having fun.
